prompts.name: potting
prompts.prompt:
Restyle the supplied room as if a skilled Sierra artist drew it in an AGI picture editor in 1986, using a small budget of line strokes and flood-filled areas. Preserve the same composition, building silhouettes, perspective, doorway locations, floor level and puzzle object positions EXACTLY. This image represents a native 160x168 picture; think in that coarse coordinate grid, with one-pixel stepped outlines and broad contiguous fills. The game stretches those pixels horizontally later, so KEEP the source canvas proportions and placement. Use ONLY the standard 16 EGA colors. Make a considered illustration within those limits, with slightly irregular drawn outlines, asymmetric foliage silhouettes, angular rock planes, selective architectural detail and strong shadow shapes. Much of each wall, floor, tree crown or rock face must remain a single uninterrupted color. Stone joints should be a FEW short broken strokes, not a full brick grid; wood grain only a few deliberate marks; foliage a few jagged light-green clusters against green/black masses. Preserve charm and specific shapes. No procedural speckle, scattered texture pixels, stippling, dithering, soft shading, gradients, glossy lighting, realistic texture, or modern highly detailed pixel art. Also no generic geometric blockout, circular lollipop trees, perfectly repetitive patterns, or childish coloring-book simplification. NO text, characters, UI, borders, labels. The result should feel like an original low-memory adventure screen, not a photograph reduced to 16 colors.

Gardener's potting shed: irregular rafters overhead, small rear window, timber bench at back, pots, spare planks at left, broad open flagstone floor below. Keep the bottom-center exit offscreen and bench at existing height.
